purpose: Prepare exact full-document extracted-text lengths. No ratio or numerical admission is made by this packet.
scope: The independently accepted 30-row principal-results contract permits full source-manuscript length with all corrections, retained inputs, and excluded ancillary claims visible. It does not assert that every historical assertion is rederived.

unit_definitions.alphanumeric_units: len(re.findall(r"[^\W_]+", normalized_text)) with Python Unicode semantics
unit_definitions.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in normalized_text)

extraction: pypdf 6.13.0, page.extract_text(), every physical page in order, joined by one newline; font visitors must exactly reconstruct extraction.
selection: Every extracted character is initially included. Only exact declared running headers and printed page numbers are removed; title, abstract, references, unique journal banner and copyright, addresses and footnotes remain.
calibration: Before normalization, replace only the eight individually bound font/glyph occurrences by their visually identified Unicode forms. Keep four parenthesis pieces as four pieces. Do not delete or coalesce them.
symmetric_policy: The same complete-page extraction, font/control inspection, permitted visual-glyph calibration, furniture-only exclusion, normalization and metrics apply to all source and replacement documents. A document with no suspect glyph receives no substitution.
printed_hyphens: All printed/extracted hyphens remain. No dehyphenation.
source_representation_limit: This is an extracted-text coordinate, not a complete visible-text or graphic-cost coordinate. L030 page 5 vector graphs/edges/layout remain unmeasured; some extracted figure labels are visually obscured. N008 bibliography underline glyphs remain in the extraction.
whole_topic_denominator: The full U_B and all four complete applications. No discount for overlap with another topic.
code_policy: All mathematical arguments are written uniformly. Lean/check/render utilities and finite validation models are separate verification infrastructure, not unpriced proof-producing computations.
conditional_local_comparison: If later admitted, each c(L_i)/c(B_i) is conditional on already acquiring the full U_B. No required mathematical program exists here. The N001 PDF conditional remains null.
retained_costs: The retained original/classical inputs are explicit in the exact source map. Their expanded proof costs are unknown, not zero; no all-dependency complexity is claimed.
reader_exclusion: The two-page scope.pdf and audit/readme material are not scientific proof premises and are separately identified.
